label: Hypospadias
reason: Male-only and not prenatally diagnosable; there is no detection-and-termination channel at all. The strongest available control. Prevalence trend left at zero: level shift of -16.3% at 2019 (z=-6.0), so the fitted slope averages a discontinuity rather than measuring a trend; dispersion 5.01 against a limit of 3.00, so a straight line does not describe the series and its slope is not a prevalence trend.

label: Cleft palate alone
reason: Poorly detectable on routine prenatal ultrasound because the secondary palate is obscured; termination for isolated cleft palate is essentially unrecorded in the US. Caution: definitionally exclusive with ca_cleft but co-flagged on 16.3% of its records over 2016-2024 so the two are not independent controls; dropping it changes the fitted total by 16 births and widens the interval slightly. Prevalence trend pinned to -0.00118 log per year (SE 0.00657) from Texas Birth Defects Registry Annual Report, Table 2A, deliveries 1999-2022 (Texas DSHS, September 2025); active surveillance, diagnoses abstracted from medical records, 2010-2022.

label: Cleft lip with or without cleft palate
reason: Detectable prenatally from the second trimester but isolated cleft lip is essentially never terminated in the US. Prevalence trend pinned to -0.00281 log per year (SE 0.00495) from Texas Birth Defects Registry Annual Report, Table 2A, deliveries 1999-2022 (Texas DSHS, September 2025); active surveillance, diagnoses abstracted from medical records, 2010-2022.

label: Limb reduction defect
reason: Detectable prenatally; termination is rare and confined to severe multi-limb cases. Prevalence trend pinned to -0.00648 log per year (SE 0.00537) from Texas Birth Defects Registry Annual Report, Table 2A, deliveries 1999-2022 (Texas DSHS, September 2025); active surveillance, diagnoses abstracted from medical records, 2010-2022.

label: Gastroschisis
reason: Has no material reduction channel and would otherwise qualify as a control. Excluded because its true US birth prevalence is genuinely falling after a long rise: its composition-adjusted recorded rate falls 25.9% over 2016-2018 to 2022-2024. Attributing that to recording would be wrong. Prevalence trend pinned to -0.03798 log per year (SE 0.00533) from Texas Birth Defects Registry Annual Report, Table 2A, deliveries 1999-2022 (Texas DSHS, September 2025); active surveillance, diagnoses abstracted from medical records, 2010-2022.

label: Cyanotic congenital heart disease
reason: Ascertainment changed independently of the shared item: universal newborn pulse-oximetry screening was phased in across the states over 2011-2018. Its composition-adjusted recorded rate rose 14.6% over 2016-2018 to 2022-2024 while every control fell. Retained as a named negative control rather than dropped silently. Prevalence trend not pinned: no active-surveillance series extracted for this condition.

label: Anencephaly
reason: Near-universal termination after prenatal detection makes the recorded rate a reduction signal rather than a recording signal. Prevalence trend not pinned: no active-surveillance series extracted for this condition.

label: Meningomyelocele / spina bifida
reason: Substantial termination after prenatal detection. Prevalence trend not pinned: no active-surveillance series extracted for this condition.

label: Congenital diaphragmatic hernia
reason: Reliably detected prenatally with some termination; the recorded rate mixes both channels. Prevalence trend not pinned: no active-surveillance series extracted for this condition.

label: Omphalocele
reason: Frequently associated with a chromosomal abnormality and so shares the Down syndrome detection-and-termination channel directly. Prevalence trend not pinned: no active-surveillance series extracted for this condition.

label: Suspected chromosomal disorder other than Down syndrome
reason: Shares the Down syndrome prenatal-detection and termination channel directly and responds to the same NIPT rollout; it is a co-outcome rather than a control. Not populated in the current extract in any case. Prevalence trend not pinned: no active-surveillance series extracted for this condition.
